basis: Metabolic crises, neurodevelopmental impairment and rhabdomyolysis define disease; cardiac electrical dysfunction is common (QT prolongation 8/13); frequent GI dysmotility omitted at cap.
Benign neoplasm arising in the autonomic peripheral nervous system.
White matter hypoplasia, callosal agenesis and intellectual disability define the disease; facial dysmorphism does not establish other organ damage.
Microcephaly and profound developmental impairment define disease; non-neurologic findings have small selected denominators and do not establish prevalence of at least 30%.
Omphalocele, laryngopharyngeal hypoplasia and scoliosis define syndrome; developmental impairment occurs in 80-99%. Eyelid and eyebrow morphology alone does not establish damage.
Dystonia combined with another neurologic movement disorder; other organ involvement is not shared across the umbrella.
Isolated inherited myocardial disease with ventricular dilation, systolic dysfunction and sometimes noncompaction.
Malignant neoplasm of the eyelid, explicitly including eyelid skin; both ocular and cutaneous origins are represented.
Indolent B-cell lymphoma involving lymphoplasmacytic blood-cell lineage; lymphoma warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Air and blood occupy the pleural cavity; pleural bleeding does not itself constitute a blood-cell or coagulation disorder.
Malignancy of steroid-producing Leydig endocrine cells of the gonad; metastatic sites are not established as commonly involved.
Cassava-associated cyanogenic poisoning causes persistent toxic neurologic injury with ataxic neuropathy or spastic motor impairment.
Inborn amino acid metabolism disorder; no additional organ damage is established across this metabolic umbrella.
Inherited retinal degeneration with abnormal cone function, night blindness and visual loss.
Carcinoma originates in the epithelial lining of the vermiform appendix.
Cardiac malformations, microcephaly with developmental impairment, and hypoplastic thumbs/metacarpals define syndrome; other organ abnormalities lack established frequency.
Disseminated Candida infection; organ seeding varies, with no individual additional organ established here as damaged in at least 30%.
Inherited atrial myocardial and electrical dysfunction; stroke is a separately diagnosed complication with unspecified frequency.
Congenital right ventricular hypoplasia with intracardiac shunting and ventricular dysfunction; hypoxemia does not establish pulmonary damage.
Isolated inherited diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma without associated systemic manifestations.
Airway, esophageal/palatal and urethral malformations define syndrome; neurodevelopmental impairment occurs in 30-79%; frequent ptosis omitted at the four-axis cap.
Benign adipose soft-tissue neoplasm of the chest wall, generally subcutaneous; no specified muscle, bone or pleural origin.
Axonal peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy; muscle weakness reflects denervation, while scoliosis and talipes occur in only 5-29%.
Intellectual disability defines this inherited neurodevelopmental umbrella; other organ abnormalities vary among its constituent syndromes.
Mature T-cell blood/marrow malignancy classified within T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma; associated autoimmune diseases are separate diagnoses.
